5056486884592.sourceDescription:
Bring festive charm to your home with this 5FT Artificial Christmas Tree, designed to create an attractive centrepiece for your seasonal decorations. Featuring realistic-looking branches and a traditional green finish, this tree provides a classic Christmas appearance that can be decorated to suit your own festive style.

The generous branches provide plenty of space for hanging baubles, lights, tinsel and other Christmas decorations. At approximately 5ft tall, the tree is a practical size for living rooms, dining areas, offices and other indoor spaces without taking up the room required by larger trees.

Get your home ready for the festive season with this artificial christmas tree. It is 5FT in size. It adds a cheerful Christmas touch to living rooms, hallways, mantels and windows.

Mix and match it with your existing decorations to create the look you want. When the holidays are over, pack it away safely and bring it out again next year. It is ideal for Christmas parties, family gatherings and anyone who loves a festive home.
REALISTIC FESTIVE APPEARANCE – Designed with natural-looking green branches to create the classic appearance of a traditional Christmas tree and bring a warm festive feel to your home.
5FT / 1.52M HEIGHT – A practical Christmas tree size for living rooms, dining rooms, offices, reception areas and other indoor festive displays.
FULL GREEN BRANCHES – Multiple green branches provide plenty of space for decorating with baubles, lights, tinsel, ribbons and your favourite Christmas ornaments.
⭐ DECORATE IT YOUR WAY – The classic green design provides a versatile base for traditional, modern, colourful or minimalist Christmas decorations.
STURDY METAL STAND – Supplied with a solid metal stand designed to provide reliable support while the tree is displayed throughout the festive season.
IDEAL FOR INDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAYS – Suitable for decorating living rooms, hallways, offices, shops, reception areas and other indoor spaces.
REUSABLE SEASONAL DECORATION – An artificial design that can be packed away after Christmas and brought out again for future festive seasons.

Merry Christmas!

Wish You a Happy and Warm Festival Time with Our Luxurious Christmas Tree!
The 6 ft pre-lit artificial Christmas tree can be the perfect centerpiece for your festive celebrations. The 788 dense branch tips, adorned with two types of leaves with different textures (PE and PVC leaves), create a realistic and full appearance that will impress your guests. Moreover, with 280 built-in warm-white LED lights and 8 lighting modes, you can easily customize the ambiance to suit your festive mood. Besides, crafted from fire-resistant PVC and supported by a stable and sturdy crossed metal base, our tree ensures both safety and durability. Furthermore, the hinged structure and 3-section design make installation a breeze, allowing you to enjoy the festivities in no time. This versatile lighted Xmas tree is suitable for decorating various occasions and brings a rich holiday atmosphere to your home, office, or event. Create magical memories and cherish the holiday spirit with this stunning centerpiece.
Luxurious & Vivid Appearance: The 6 ft artificial Christmas tree features 788 lush branch tips, providing a lifelike appearance that will impress your guests. Moreover, there exist 2 types of leaves, which are soft PE leaves and verdant PVC leaves, looking more realistic from near to far.
Pre-Lit Design & 8 Lighting Modes: The pre-lit Christmas tree is equipped with 280 bright warm-white LED lights, creating a cozy and festival atmosphere in your home. Premium earth-tone flocked bauble collection for commercial festive styling. The matte chocolate brown velour texture delivers understated luxury, ideal for creating high-end rustic Christmas atmospheres.

32pcs per set, 6cm per piece. 5 sculpted styles: smooth sphere, ribbed ball, diamond-quilted ball, heart and bow. Semi-handmade flocking, shatterproof plastic construction, compartment packaging for safe transport.
【Application】
Designed for boutique shops, cafes, homestays, event layouts and window displays. Can be matched with dried plants and lights for holiday visual merchandising, reusable year after year.
【Precautions】
Recommended for indoor display only. Flocked surface is sensitive to friction and moisture. Prohibit water washing. Avoid sharp props. Keep unattended toddlers away. Store separately in the divided box between festive seasons.

Add a touch of elegance and charm to your tree with this ornaments
【Easy to Hang】The Christmas tree ornaments are equipped with a metal buckle and hanging rope, durable and reliable, easy to hang, offering functionality and aesthetics, eliminating the stress of sourcing for additional materials or tools to get your tree set up, adding a relaxing atmosphere to your house
【Versatile Occasions】This velvet Christmas balls ornaments are suitable for Christmas decoration,ideal decor for Christmas tree,wall,fireplace, window,etc.Best choice for Christmas party, school, office, home indoor outdoor, birthday party, etc.Create a warm festive atmosphere in your house
【Notes】The product consists of hollow plastic spheres, which may become partially dented during transport due to friction and pressure; if this occurs, you can contact us at any time for a free exchange or return.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The brown finish and copper construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

A flexible finishing touch

5056797098992.sourceDescription:
Bring natural, rustic charm to your festive display with this 111cm rattan light up reindeer from MySmartBuy. It combines brown rattan detailing with a durable metal frame and is lit with 351 warm white LEDs for a warm, inviting glow. At 111cm it is a great size for front gardens, lawns and entrances. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Ground spikes are included to hold it securely on lawns, in borders and beside pathways. Light up figures are one of the easiest ways to make your home stand out at Christmas. Group several together to tell a festive story on the lawn, use them to frame the front door or path, or place one where it can be seen from the window so the whole family can enjoy it from inside too. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. At a glance: 111cm rattan reindeer | brown rattan detailing | metal frame | 351 warm white LEDs | ground spikes included | 5m lead cable | BS IP20 transformer | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | outdoor use.
111CM RATTAN REINDEER : 351 warm white LEDs on a durable metal frame with brown rattan detailing.
RUSTIC CHARM : A natural look that suits traditional and country-style displays.
5M LEAD CABLE : Supplied with a 5m lead cable and BS IP20 transformer, giving plenty of reach from your socket to your chosen spot.
AUTOMATIC TIMER : Built-in 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer, so it lights up at the same time every evening without you having to remember.
OUTDOOR CHRISTMAS DISPLAY : Gardens, lawns, porches, entrances and commercial displays.

5096042275792.baseName: Gold Christmas wreath - Rattan-style door wreath with decorative branches for indoor and outdoor Christmas displays - Gold, 55 cm
5096042275792.variantName: Gold Christmas wreath - Rattan-style door wreath with decorative branches for indoor and outdoor Christmas displays - Gold, 55 cm
5096042275792.sourceDescription:
Gold-toned branches give this wreath an airy, rattan-style outline. The branch pattern is decorative in its own right, so you can leave the ring simple or repeat the gold in ribbon and other decorations nearby. It can be used indoors or outdoors, so the same decoration can move between a hallway and an entrance as your plans change. At 55 cm across, it is easy to measure out the space it will occupy before choosing a position.

A wreath puts the decoration on the door or wall itself, leaving the console or mantelpiece below free for cards and winter flowers. Its outline is complete in one piece, which is handy in an entrance where there is little space for a tree. A green wreath also works as a bridge between rooms. Choose one shade from your tree decorations for the hallway and repeat it in a small accent beside the wreath, letting the greenery carry the rest of the scheme.

The centre opening lets the background play a part in the design. Pale paint gives the foliage a sharp outline, while a darker panel draws attention to the texture at the tips of the branches. For a simpler finish, keep additional decorations to one part of the ring and let the natural shape of the foliage show elsewhere. A ribbon tied off-centre can pick up a colour from the tree without covering the sprigs.

For an entrance used throughout the day, use a fixing suited to the door finish and the weight of the decoration. A trial positioning helps you check the view from both sides of an open door before committing to a spot. A simple way to plan the setting is to mark the centre of the intended space with a small piece of paper. Hold the decoration over it, then step back to see how it sits alongside the door surround or other wall decorations.

If you already have a busy Christmas tree, give the wreath a space of its own.
Gold rattan-style branches create an airy, decorative outline for festive displays.
Versatile design suitable for both indoor and outdoor Christmas decoration use.
Compact 55 cm diameter size fits easily on doors or walls without occupying floor space.
Complete one-piece construction offers a ready-to-hang solution with no assembly required.

Create a spectacular festive focal point with this 60cm Light Up Christmas Wreath, designed to bring an impressive glow to your home throughout the Christmas season.

The circular gold metal frame is wrapped with delicate pin wire lighting and finished with a statement red bow, creating an elegant contemporary take on the traditional Christmas wreath. An incredible 2000 warm white and red LEDs illuminate the design, producing a dense, sparkling display that looks striking both switched on and off.

A built-in timer makes daily use effortless. Once activated, the wreath remains illuminated for 6 hours before automatically switching off for 18 hours, repeating at the same time each day without the need to manually operate the lights. The decoration is mains powered and supplied with a generous 5 metre power cable, giving you additional flexibility when positioning it around your home.

Suitable for indoor and outdoor use.

5M MAINS POWER CABLE: Mains powered for reliable seasonal lighting and supplied with a generous 5 metre cable for flexible positioning.

7984704591992.baseName: COSTWAY 2.4M Inflatable Christmas Nutcracker Soldier w/ 3 LED Lights Blow Up Xmas Decoration
7984704591992.variantName: COSTWAY 2.4M Inflatable Christmas Nutcracker Soldier w/ 3 LED Lights Blow Up Xmas Decoration
7984704591992.sourceDescription:
Our 2.4M inflatable Christmas nutcracker soldier will bring you a special and delightful Christmas holiday experience!
Made of waterproof polyester fabric, this nutcracker is able for you to use in a long time. With its realistic appearance, the giant blows up soldier will become a unique addition to your home. And the built-in 3 LED lights also keep it bright at night, making it possible for you to appreciate it clearly all day. Apart from this, the package also contains a blower for you to inflate it upon receiving. You don’t have to worry about its stability since the package will include 2 ropes and 2 metal stakes for you to stabilize it on the ground. Last but not least, it can be placed indoor or outdoor according to your needs. If you are looking for a different Christmas decoration, this nutcracker is your best choice!
Realistic Nutcracker Soldier Appearance: This inflatable soldier mimics the appearance of nutcracker soldier in the cartoon with its rich colors and delicate details. It also has a candy scepter held in the hand which makes it more vivid. Compared to traditional Christmas trees, this is an unique decoration for the Christmas season.
Best Christmas Decoration: This soldier's inflatable design makes it a portable decoration in many places. In addition to being used at home, it can also be placed in front of shopping malls or hotels to greet guests. Moreover, inflating it in schools will bring children more happiness during the Christmas.
Built-in 3 LED Lights: The nutcracker is equipped with 3 LED lights, which will keep bright at night so as to make you appreciate it clearly. And the warm light will create a better Christmas atmosphere, thus adding more joy to your family. With its glowing effect, you can use it to impress the guests and make your yard shinny.
Easy Inflation & Deflation: The package contains a 12V blower for you to quickly inflate the soldier upon receiving. It also has 2 ropes and 2 metal stakes to help you stabilize it on the ground. In addition, it can be deflated in a short time with a smooth zipper, making it possible for you to store in a box for next use.
Suitable for Indoor and Outdoor: This Christmas soldier is 2.4M tall, really suitable for placing on the porch or the grassland in your backyard. What's more, you can also put it in the living room. Apart from this, the waterproof polyester fabric and the GS certified adaptor will both ensure its safety whether it is placed inside or outside.
Specifications: Material: Polyester Fabric Inflated Height: 2.4 m Voltage of Blower: 12V, 0.8A Input Voltage of Adaptor: 100 - 240V, 50/60HZ Weight: 1.5 KG Package includes： 1 x 2.4 m Inflatable Christmas Nutcracker Soldier 1 x Blower 1 x GS Certified Adaptor 2 x Metal Stakes 2 x Ropes 1 x User’s Manual
